title: Jachʼa jachʼa tukuñ palacio manqhankir nina naktäwi
intro: Nayra pachan wali ch’aman palacion jach’a pirqanakap qhipäxanx mä jaqiw jakasïna, chuymapanx mä imantat apt’ataw jikxatasïna, janiw mä reyin kamachipax amukt’aykaspati. Taqi chiqan kʼari diosanakar qunqurtʼasiskäna ukhaxa, uka almax amukiw iyawsäwip chuymapan nakhantäna. Uka markan apnaqeripajj Diosankapjjatap amuyapjjäna, ukampis uka jaqejj chuymachtʼañat sipansa cheqa yatichäwinakwa ajllïna, jan kuna jan waltʼäwin uñjasiñat sipansa Diosar taqe chuyma yupaychañwa ajllïna. Jichhürunakanxa, lurawimax khitis uka jan axsart’ir almax uk yatxatañawa, jupan sarnaqäwipax jan mayjt’ir iyawsäwin wali ch’aman uñacht’äwinakapat maynïriw qhiparaski.
clues: Wali qamirïki ukat jan uñtasit jachʼa cheqanwa jakasiyäta, ukanjja oraq apnaqeriw taqe kunjjar taqe chʼamanïkäna.
Naya jakʼankirinakajj kʼari diosanakar altʼasipkäna ukhajja, chuymajan mä amuktʼat iyawsäwi qhanampiw uñjayäta.
Mä wawaruw jikxatta ukat uywata, jupax mä jan uñt’at thakhin nayar apaniwayi - janiw yurïwipatkiti, jan ukasti mä jach’a jawir uma taypinwa.
Tatitujaruw mayisiyäta, Jupan jakʼapan Paraison mä uta utjañapataki ukat muyuntat tiranía ukan qhespiyatäñapataki.
Uk uywawaykta uka wawax destinojar apnaqir apnaqiri pachparuw chʼaxwañatak jilsuwayi, ukat ajjsarayatäkasas iyawsäwijanx chʼamañchtʼataw jikxatasirïta.
Nayax khititix sutipax Quran ukanx jach’añchatawa mä modelo de creencia ukhama, ukat nayax pachpa Faraonan palaciopan jakawayta.

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
